mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (username, email, password, age, gender, nickname, avatar_url, login_status, status, created_at, updated_at, last_login_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, #{password}, #{age}, #{gender}, #{nickname}, #{avatarUrl}, #{loginStatus}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{lastLoginAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET last_login_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
